text: Appointments to the Scadding Court Community Centre Board of Management is a matter for which the Community Council has been delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision, provided that the recommendations do not vary from the Public Appointments Policy. The nominees are qualified to serve on the Board of Management, pursuant to the terms established by the Relationship Framework for Board-Run Community Centres and the City of Toronto’s Public Appointments Policy. By this letter, the Board of Management requests that all individuals named be appointed as Directors on the Board of Management of Scadding Court Community Centre. On behalf of the Board of Management, I respectfully request the City take the necessary steps to implement the above requested appointments.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidate to the Scadding Court Community Centre Board of Management, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending, June 30, 2022, or until a successor is appointed: Stephanie Donaldson
